title: eugenia acapulcensis
intro: Eugenia acapulcensis, commonly known as Mexican strawberry or Agua de Temazcal, is a plant species in the family Myrtaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues. The health benefits of Eugenia acapulcensis include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which help in reducing stress and promoting overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, contributing to its therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, antidiarrheal, and anti-ulcer properties.
